rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 季節窗判定：evaluation 取值為 window_open / window_closed（由 seasonal-calendar.json 的例年窗與今年實況窗對拍日曆得出；實況優先，兩者皆缺時誠實 not_evaluatable）。
rationale_i18n.en: Seasonal-window verdict: the evaluation value is window_open / window_closed (resolved by matching the calendar date against typical and current-season windows in seasonal-calendar.json; observed takes precedence, and with neither present the genre is honestly not_evaluatable).
rationale_i18n.ja: 季節窓判定：評価値は window_open/window_closed（seasonal-calendar.json の例年窓・当年窓と日付の突き合わせで決定。実況優先、どちらも欠ければ誠実に not_evaluatable）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 降雨 <0.2 mm/h：花田步道基本可拍（沿用已審門檻）；微雨對花景反而有水珠加分效果，不設下限。
rationale_i18n.en: Precipitation < 0.2 mm/h: basic shootability of flower fields and trails (approved threshold carried over); light drizzle adds droplet charm, so no lower bound is imposed.
rationale_i18n.ja: 降水<0.2mm/h。花畑・遊歩道の基本撮影可否。小雨は水滴として好条件のため下限は設けない。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 風 <5 m/s：花穗搖曳是構圖元素、強風破壞拍攝（金針花特寫/芒草逆光都禁強風）。5 為 provisional，可依主題差異化（芒草或許更寬）。
rationale_i18n.en: Wind < 5 m/s: sway is compositional up to a point, gale ruins the shot (daylily close-ups and backlit silvergrass both need calm). 5 is provisional and may be differentiated per plant (silvergrass might tolerate more).
rationale_i18n.ja: 風<5m/s。揺れは構図要素だが強風は撮影不能。5は暫定値で植物ごとの差別化も可。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 金色時刻窗＝太陽高度 +6° 至 -6°：暖色低角度直射光的時段。
rationale_i18n.en: Golden-hour window = sun elevation +6 to -6 deg: the warm low-angle direct-light period.
rationale_i18n.ja: ゴールデンアワー帯＝太陽高度+6〜-6度。暖色の低角度直射光の時間帯。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 低雲 lte 55%（provisional）：低雲不封鎖縱谷與花田；雲隙光光柱主要由中高雲供給（下條），連續低雲幕以外的雲況不再以總雲量一票否決。
rationale_i18n.en: Low cloud <= 55% (provisional): low cloud must not block the valley and flower fields; crepuscular-ray beams are mainly supplied by mid/high cloud (next condition), so cloud situations other than a continuous low-cloud deck are no longer vetoed by a single total-cloud figure.
rationale_i18n.ja: 下層雲 lte 55%（暫定）：下層雲が谷と花畑を塞がないこと；薄明光柱は中・上層雲が主に供給（次の条件）。連続した下層雲の帳以外は、全雲量の一括否決を廃止。

notes_i18n.zh-TW: 2026-11-06 CL-DATA-14（CL-PHOTO-02 委託書稽查修正）：原 C-tw-035-P02-05 cloud_cover_total lte 50 以總雲量代理，語義矛盾：連續雲幕可通過、碎積雲反被否決。修正照 sunset/夕照級總雲、低雲分層慣例：改 cloud_cover_low lte 55 ＋ 新增 C-tw-035-P02-06 cloud_cover_mid_and_high between [20,70]（provisional）。本筆為語意修正，layering parity gate 豁免，理由記於本註記。
notes_i18n.en: 2026-11-06 CL-DATA-14 (CL-PHOTO-02 photographer-brief audit correction): Original C-tw-035-P02-05 cloud_cover_total lte 50 used total cloud as a proxy — a semantic contradiction: a continuous cloud deck passed while broken cumulus was vetoed. Corrected per the sunset-style total/low-cloud layering convention: cloud_cover_low lte 55 plus new C-tw-035-P02-06 cloud_cover_mid_and_high between [20,70] (provisional). Semantic correction; layering parity gate exempt; rationale in this note.
notes_i18n.ja: 2026-11-06 CL-DATA-14（CL-PHOTO-02 撮影依頼書監査修正）：旧 C-tw-035-P02-05 cloud_cover_total lte 50 は全雲量代理で意味矛盾（連続雲帳は通過、積雲は否決）。sunset の総雲/下層雲分層慣例に従い修正：cloud_cover_low lte 55 ＋ 新規 C-tw-035-P02-06 cloud_cover_mid_and_high between [20,70]（暫定）。意味修正のため layering parity gate 豁免。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 中高雲 20–70%（provisional）：中高雲供給雲隙光光柱與天光染色，全晴無光柱、全陰無光隙。
rationale_i18n.en: Mid/high cloud 20-70% (provisional): mid/high cloud supplies the crepuscular-ray beams and sky colour; clear sky has no beams, full overcast has no gaps.
rationale_i18n.ja: 中・上層雲 20–70%（暫定）：薄明光柱と空の彩りを中・上層雲が供給；快晴では光柱なし、全曇では隙間なし。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: AOD ≤0.6：適度氣溶膠暖化光線但 >0.6 時太陽盤面與主體輪廓被吞沒（與 mountain_view/sunset 同一上限，同一物理）。
rationale_i18n.en: AOD <= 0.6: moderate aerosols warm the light but beyond 0.6 the solar disc and subject silhouettes are swallowed (same ceiling as mountain_view/sunset, same physics).
rationale_i18n.ja: AOD≤0.6。適度なエアロゾルは光を暖色化するが、0.6超では太陽面と輪郭が埋没（mountain_view/sunsetと同一上限）。
